name: ANSI/IEEE push-to-test indicator lamp symbol
summary: IEEE-oriented graphical reference for push-to-test indicator lamp, with public vendor evidence and drawing-reading notes.
description: The press-to-test lamp form combines indication and a documented local test path. The normal signal and test supply may be different circuit paths, and the test does not automatically verify the monitored equipment feedback.

This is a convention-specific lookup based on the publisher's IEEE-labelled preview. The geometry here is independently drawn to explain the connection or operation; it is not a certified reproduction of the standard graphic.
readingNotes: Trace the test path independently of the normal alarm or status contact.
Read the selected library and the project legend together. A vendor block identifier is meaningful within its named library and is not a universal standard-symbol code.
distinction: A lamp-test operation and a complete alarm-system test are different verification functions.
